svg.title: The four shuttle contractors after the Challenger explosion
svg.desc: All published vector markers from Maloney and Mulherin (2003), Figure 1, expressed as percent change from each opening price. Morton Thiokol, marked with squares, has the greatest sustained decline and a gap in observations during its trading halt. The vertical reference marks the 11:39 explosion. Points are not joined across trading gaps.
